def test_surrogate_filename_no_crash(self):
        # https://github.com/nedbat/coveragepy/issues/XXXX
        # Files with surrogate characters in their filenames should be
        # skipped gracefully with a warning, not crash with UnicodeEncodeError.
        warnings = []
        def warn_fn(msg, slug=None, once=False):
            warnings.append(msg)

        covdata = CoverageData(no_disk=True, warn=warn_fn)
        # Add line data with a filename containing a surrogate character
        surrogate_file = "/path/to/\udcff.py"
        covdata.add_lines({surrogate_file: {1: None, 2: None}})

        # No lines should have been recorded for the surrogate file
        # since it couldn't be encoded to UTF-8
        self.assertEqual(covdata.lines(surrogate_file), None)

        # A warning should have been issued about the unencodable filename
        self.assertTrue(any("surrogate" in w.lower() or "encode" in w.lower() for w in warnings))

    def test_surrogate_filename_arc_data(self):
        # Same test but for arc data
        warnings = []
        def warn_fn(msg, slug=None, once=False):
            warnings.append(msg)

        covdata = CoverageData(no_disk=True, warn=warn_fn)
        surrogate_file = "/path/to/\udcff.py"
        covdata.add_arcs({surrogate_file: {(-1, 1): None, (1, -1): None}})

        # No arcs should have been recorded for the surrogate file
        self.assertEqual(covdata.arcs(surrogate_file), None)

        # A warning should have been issued
        self.assertTrue(any("surrogate" in w.lower() or "encode" in w.lower() for w in warnings))
